description: Flat metadata schema for individual marine sequencing samples from water, sediment, and organism-associated microbiomes, including collection context, environmental conditions, nucleic-acid extraction, and sequencing details.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual sample record; must be stable and unique within and across studies if possible.

study_id.descr: Identifier for the parent study or project to which the sample belongs.

sample_name.descr: Human-readable sample name or label used in the lab or sequencing pipeline.

sample_type.descr: Primary matrix sampled; controlled values such as water, sediment, organism_microbiome, biofilm, or other.

sample_subtype.descr: More specific sample category if applicable, such as seawater, pore_water, surface_sediment, deep_sediment, gut_microbiome, skin_microbiome, mucus_microbiome, or rhizosphere-like marine analogs.

ocean_region.descr: Broad oceanic region where the sample was collected, for example Atlantic Ocean, Pacific Ocean, Indian Ocean, Southern Ocean, Arctic Ocean, Mediterranean Sea, or other named marine region.

marine_ecosystem.descr: Environmental setting or ecosystem classification, such as coastal, open_ocean, estuary, shelf, deep_sea, hydrothermal_vent, coral_reef, mangrove, sea_ice, or upwelling_zone.

site_name.descr: Name of the sampling site, station, cruise station, transect point, or habitat location.

latitude.descr: Sampling latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), negative values for south.

longitude.descr: Sampling longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), negative values for west.

location_precision_m.descr: Estimated positional uncertainty of the sampling location in meters.

sampling_date.descr: Date of sample collection in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

sampling_time.descr: Local or UTC time of sample collection if available; use a consistent format and specify in accompanying documentation if needed.

timezone.descr: Time zone used for sampling_time, preferably an IANA time zone name or offset such as UTC or UTC+10.

depth_m.descr: Sampling depth in meters below sea surface or below sediment surface, depending on sample type; if using sediment depth, state convention consistently in project documentation.

depth_reference.descr: Reference frame for depth measurement, such as sea_surface, seafloor, sediment_surface, or organism_body_site.

water_temperature_c.descr: In situ water temperature at sampling time in degrees Celsius.

salinity_psu.descr: Salinity at sampling time in practical salinity units (PSU).

ph.descr: Measured pH of the sampled water or pore water; if not applicable or unavailable, leave blank.

dissolved_oxygen_mg_l.descr: Dissolved oxygen concentration in milligrams per liter at sampling time.

conductivity_mS_cm.descr: Electrical conductivity of the sampled water in mS/cm, if measured.

turbidity_ntu.descr: Turbidity in nephelometric turbidity units (NTU), if measured.

chlorophyll_a_ug_l.descr: Chlorophyll a concentration in micrograms per liter, if measured.

nutrient_nitrate_umol_l.descr: Nitrate concentration in micromoles per liter, if measured.

nutrient_phosphate_umol_l.descr: Phosphate concentration in micromoles per liter, if measured.

nutrient_silicate_umol_l.descr: Silicate concentration in micromoles per liter, if measured.

light_condition.descr: Ambient light condition at sampling time, such as day, night, twilight, surface_light, or dark.

weather_condition.descr: Qualitative description of weather or sea-state conditions during sampling, if relevant.

water_mass.descr: Named water mass or hydrographic feature, if known.

sediment_grain_size_class.descr: Sediment texture or grain-size class, such as clay, silt, sand, gravel, mixed, or unknown; applicable mainly to sediment samples.

sediment_organic_matter_pct.descr: Sediment organic matter content as percent by mass, if measured.

sediment_redox_potential_mv.descr: Redox potential of sediment in millivolts, if measured.

host_organism_taxon.descr: Taxonomic identification of the marine host organism for organism-associated microbiomes, preferably at species level if known.

host_organism_common_name.descr: Common name of the host organism, if applicable.

host_life_stage.descr: Life stage of the host organism, such as larva, juvenile, adult, or unknown.

host_body_site.descr: Body site or compartment sampled from the host organism, such as gut, gill, skin, mucus, shell_surface, or whole_body.

sample_volume_l.descr: Volume of water sampled in liters, if applicable.

sample_mass_g.descr: Mass of sediment or biomass sampled in grams, if applicable.

filter_pore_size_um.descr: Filter pore size used for biomass capture in micrometers, if applicable.

size_fraction_min_um.descr: Lower bound of size fraction retained, in micrometers, if size fractionation was used.

size_fraction_max_um.descr: Upper bound of size fraction retained, in micrometers, if size fractionation was used.

pre_filter_used.descr: Whether a pre-filter was used before collection or final filtration.

sample_preservation_method.descr: Preservation method used immediately after collection, such as flash_freezing, liquid_nitrogen, ethanol, RNAlater, dry_ice, or none.

storage_temperature_c.descr: Storage temperature after collection and before extraction, in degrees Celsius.

storage_duration_days.descr: Time between collection and extraction or long-term storage benchmark, in days.

extraction_protocol_name.descr: Name or identifier of the nucleic acid extraction protocol or kit used.

extraction_kit_manufacturer.descr: Manufacturer of the extraction kit, if applicable.

extraction_date.descr: Date of nucleic acid extraction in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

extractor_name.descr: Person, laboratory, or facility that performed the extraction.

nucleic_acid_type.descr: Type of nucleic acid extracted, such as DNA, RNA, or total_nucleic_acid.

rna_dnase_treatment.descr: Whether DNase treatment was applied to RNA extracts.

library_protocol_name.descr: Name or identifier of the sequencing library preparation protocol.

library_layout.descr: Library layout, such as single_end or paired_end.

insert_size_bp.descr: Expected or average library insert size in base pairs, if known.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument or platform, such as Illumina NovaSeq, NextSeq, MiSeq, PacBio, or Oxford Nanopore.

sequencing_center.descr: Facility or center where sequencing was performed.

sequencing_date.descr: Date of sequencing run or library submission in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs for each read end or typical read length, as appropriate for the platform.

target_marker_gene.descr: Target gene or locus if amplicon sequencing was used, such as 16S rRNA, 18S rRNA, ITS, or functional marker gene; leave blank for shotgun metagenomics.

primer_forward.descr: Forward primer sequence or identifier used for amplicon sequencing, if applicable.

primer_reverse.descr: Reverse primer sequence or identifier used for amplicon sequencing, if applicable.

metagenome_type.descr: Sequencing strategy, such as amplicon, shotgun_metagenome, metatranscriptome, or hybrid.

barcode_index.descr: Sample barcode or index sequence identifier used for multiplexing.

lane_id.descr: Sequencing lane or run identifier, if applicable.

run_id.descr: Sequencing run identifier assigned by the instrument or facility.

quality_control_passed.descr: Whether the sample passed predefined quality-control criteria for downstream analysis.

contamination_check_result.descr: Outcome of contamination screening, such as pass, suspect, fail, or not_performed.

sequencing_depth_reads.descr: Total number of raw reads generated for the sample.

post_qc_reads.descr: Number of reads retained after quality control and filtering.

assembly_performed.descr: Whether de novo assembly was performed for this sample.

assembly_version.descr: Assembly pipeline or version used, if assembly was performed.

binning_performed.descr: Whether metagenome binning or genome recovery was performed.

functional_annotation_pipeline.descr: Software or pipeline used for functional annotation, if applicable.

taxonomy_assignment_pipeline.descr: Software or pipeline used for taxonomic assignment, if applicable.

reference_database.descr: Reference database used for taxonomic or functional annotation, such as SILVA, GTDB, Greengenes, KEGG, eggNOG, or custom.

bioproject_accession.descr: Public archive accession linking the sample to a BioProject, if available.

biosample_accession.descr: Public archive accession linking the sample to a BioSample, if available.

sra_accession.descr: Sequence Read Archive accession for the sample, if available.

data_release_status.descr: Data availability state, such as private, embargoed, or public.

license.descr: License or reuse terms for the sample metadata and derived data, such as CC-BY-4.0 or other declared license.

principal_investigator.descr: Name of the principal investigator or data submitter responsible for the sample record.

contact_email.descr: Contact email for the sample owner or data steward.

notes.descr: Free-text notes for unusual circumstances, deviations from protocol, or other clarifications relevant to interpretation.
